title: Sample: deploy & flag
description: A minimal, genuinely deployable AWS Challenge. Deploying stands up a single SSM Parameter holding a per-deploy random flag (TC{...}) plus a least-privilege role to read it. Read the parameter via Console / CLI and submit the TC{...} value to score. Zero-cost (SSM Standard tier).

hints.content: Read the SSM Parameter /{NamePrefix}/flag (Console: open the ParameterName output; CLI: aws ssm get-parameter --name /{NamePrefix}/flag). Submit the TC{...} value verbatim.
